citations.review_text: Game has been destroyed by nothing but bots and hackers every single lobby you join has spam bots that will constantly leave and rejoin so that the lobby will not be able to start this game seriously needs a strong anti cheat client because the bots and hackers have ruined this game

There are hackers on this game who spam join lobbies and prevent them from starting, and then while you're in game they'll crash the server which results in you getting temporarily suspended from joining online among us games which is totally unfair. Devs, please fix.

I love this game, but recently, a major issue has appeared.
The issue involves what most people would call a "hacker," although I'm not entirely sure that's what they are, they might aswell be bots.

Whenever the host starts a game, a short timer is triggered. If anyone leaves or joins during that time, the timer gets cancelled.
Recently, random accounts have started joining and leaving whenever you try to start a game. It doesn't matter if you ban them from the lobby, they'll just come back using a different username.
I've had multiple lobbies shut down because of this. It genuinely takes me over 20 minutes just to start a game, when it should normally take between 2–5 minutes.

The crazy part is that the solution to this is incredibly easy to implement: just make it so that the host is the only one who can cancel the timer.
Game is filled with bots that prevent real players from starting their lobbies. the game is unplayable in this state. additionally, hosts are getting banned from their own lobbies.

Among Us is fun. 
However. 
This game started as an IQ test of "Let's go detective mode and find out who this is, and put our heads together." 
Now, it's "It's cyan. I feel it in my heart guys." No proof, everyone follows like sheep, and you get voted out. 
Yes, you were the impostor. 
Yes, the round started 12 seconds ago and you did nothing. 
No, they won't guess anything else correct for the rest of the game.
10/10, would recommend, would rage again.

Edit: The influencer role is incredibly annoying and broken. Kinda wrecks the game, just being able to send a photo of the impostor's color. Just try to find or make a lobby without the influencer role and you'll have a much more enjoyable time.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features multiple maps and game modes, including hide-and-seek and selectable roles such as the influencer.

citations.review_text:
Among Us is a really fun and entertaining game, especially when playing with friends. The gameplay is simple but exciting, and every round brings something different. Finding the impostor, completing tasks, discussing suspicious players, and sometimes fooling everyone makes the experience hilarious.

The graphics are simple but charming, and the different maps and game modes keep things interesting. It is a great game for spending time with friends, testing your observation skills, and enjoying some funny moments.

Overall, highly recommended! It's not just a game of survival, it's a game of trust, teamwork, and betrayal!

It's Among Us, what do I have to say?

But for real, it's a fun, simple social deduction game between killers and crewmates. There's a handful of extra roles the devs have added in the last few years, but if they're not your cup of tea, you can easily disable them if you're hosting. A good time-killer.

Also, the hide-and-seek mode is HIGHLY underrated.
